container_image.status: BUILT — Python imports pass (ttnn, models, sglang), build artifacts present
container_image.blocker: JIT firmware compilation fails — ckernel_structs.h missing from tt_llk submodule, firmware_brisc.ld linker script path mismatch between new build system and base image install layout. Submodules copied in but runtime paths still misaligned.
container_image.root_cause: tt-metal e867533 changed its JIT build infrastructure. The base image (latest-rc metalium) has installed paths at /tt-metal/build_Release/libexec/tt-metalium/... while the new build expects runtime files at /tt-metal/runtime/... The build_Release install tree and the source-tree-based JIT build coexist but reference different file layouts.

overlay_test.root_cause: Model-level patches (DRAM fallbacks for Blackhole MUX) target the e867533 code paths, which differ from 89686ee78d. Overlay approach cannot work — need matching tt-metal build.

vllm_container_test.approach: Use TT vLLM container (built from e867533) as base, overlay rebase-p3b models
vllm_container_test.result: FAIL — ethernet core timeout during mesh device init
vllm_container_test.error: TT_THROW: Device 0: Timed out while waiting for active ethernet core (x=30,y=25) to become active again. Minimum tt-firmware version is 18.10.0
vllm_container_test.root_cause: Firmware compiled into e867533 does not match the on-device firmware (FW 19.6.0.0). The e867533 build's firmware interactions with the ethernet subsystem are incompatible with our P150a devices at the current flash firmware level. The old 89686ee78d build was specifically pinned to work with our FW version.
notes: Same failure on TT's own e867533-based vLLM container — proves the issue is e867533 vs our FW, not our patches
Device reset did not help — the issue is firmware protocol mismatch, not stale device state
Error consistently hits ethernet core (x=30,y=25) which is the first fabric link core

next_steps: Option A: Flash device firmware to version compatible with e867533 (requires TT firmware bundle update, risk: may break old container too)
Option B: Pick a tt-metal commit between 89686ee78d and e867533 that is compatible with FW 19.6.0
Option C: Backport BFP4/LOFI model_config changes to the 89686ee78d base (keep old tt-metal, add new model configs)
Option D: Contact TT support for recommended FW + tt-metal version pairing for P150a
